name: Yang Wan-li
bio: Yang Wan-li (楊萬里, 1127–1206) was a Sung poet.

The poems here are from the Qianjiashi (千家詩, Poems of a Thousand Poets), the Song-Ming schoolroom anthology of Tang and Song verse attributed to Xie Fangde and Wang Xiang, taken from the chinese-poetry dataset (MIT); the original characters are given as printed there.

poems.title: 傷春 (Shang chun)
poems.author: Yang Wan-li
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
準擬今春樂事濃，依然枉卻一東風。
年年不帶看花眼，不是愁中即病中。

poems.title: 初夏睡起 (Chu xia shui qi)
poems.author: Yang Wan-li
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
梅子流酸濺齒牙，芭蕉分綠上窗紗。
日長睡起無情思，閒看兒童捉柳花。
